acceptance-observer-shutdown.note: Durable acceptance and unknown outcome when its observer immediately stops the host; zero provider sends

duplicate-projection.note: 1000 matching queued retries and live queue projections; no sends or writes

queued-acceptance.note: One continued-thread acceptance behind an active provider job; prompt remains transient

queued-cancellation.note: One queued job cancelled before provider admission

queued-confirmation-refusal.note: Queued dispatch only, after acceptance/prior terminal; lock blocks before writes, native refusal holds, confirmation refusal preserves accepted IDs as unknown

queued-crash-recovery.note: One recovery transaction settles both the active and queued jobs as unknown, with no input replay

queued-dispatch-terminal.note: Prior terminal plus one queued dispatch/identity/confirmation/terminal; existing thread already explicitly named

queued-lock-refusal.note: Queued dispatch only, after acceptance/prior terminal; lock blocks before writes, native refusal holds, confirmation refusal preserves accepted IDs as unknown

queued-native-refusal.note: Queued dispatch only, after acceptance/prior terminal; lock blocks before writes, native refusal holds, confirmation refusal preserves accepted IDs as unknown

queued-shutdown.note: Graceful shutdown settles one active and one queued job without replay; setup and acceptance excluded
